First, you choose a bike that you want to use. Then you scan the QR code on the bike. This makes the bike's lock 14 (to open).
Before I rode to the park, I checked the bike carefully. Sometimes, the bikes are not 15 in good condition.
This time, everything looked fine, so I 16 headed for the park. When I got there, I returned the bike to a station in the park.
Using the bike was really easy. Also, I was happy 17 to help the environment.
